title_en: Three best paper awards at the KDCS Summer Conference 2025
body_en: Dongho Lee and Junhwa Hwang, "Battery degradation prediction using physics-informed GraphSAGE"; Muhammad Ihza Febriyan Pagri, Junhwa Hwang, and Bowoo Kim, "Maximizing the Potential of Renewable Energy Trading through the Day-Ahead Energy Market"; Jeonghwan Lee and Bowoo Kim, "Clothing search and similarity analysis system using CLIP" (advisor: Prof. Dongjun Suh).
body_ko: 이동호·황준화, 「물리 정보 기반 GraphSAGE를 이용한 배터리 열화 예측」 / M.I.F. Pagri·황준화·김보우, 「Maximizing the Potential of Renewable Energy Trading through the Day-Ahead Energy Market」 / 이정환·김보우, 「CLIP을 활용한 의류 검색 및 유사도 분석 시스템」 (지도교수: 서동준)
